Choosing a memory foam mattress

How memory foam feels

Memory foam responds to your shape as you lie on it, so the surface follows your body rather than pushing back like springs. People who like that close, contouring feel usually suit memory foam. If you prefer a bouncier surface, compare our 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress (from £220.99) or read our pocket sprung vs memory foam guide.

Getting the size right

Order the same size as your bed frame or divan base. UK sizes are named by width: Single 3ft, Small Double 4ft, Double 4ft6, King 5ft and Super King 6ft. Check your current bed or use our bed sizes guide before you order.

Using it on an ottoman or storage bed

It fits all Eagle Bed frames, divan bases and ottoman beds in the matching size, so you can order the bed and mattress together.

Before you open it

Returns are accepted within 14 days if the mattress is unused and still in its original packaging, so check the size and feel you want before you unwrap it. If you would like to talk it through first, call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm).

What does body-contouring mean?

The memory foam adjusts to your shape as you lie on it, giving a contouring feel throughout the night.

14 days for free returns if the mattress is unused and in its original packaging.

Is a memory foam mattress comfortable?

Comfort is personal. Memory foam suits people who like a mattress that contours to their shape. If you prefer a springier feel, look at our 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress or our full mattress range.

Free delivery is to your door (downstairs) across Great Britain. Choose Room of Choice Drop Off (+£29.99) under Delivery Service on this page and our team will carry it to the room you want.
